verdict.rationale: Summer Engine's own MCP server and CLI expose substantial programmatic workflows, so the axis applies and there is direct but partial support. Agents can build games, run the whole publishing flow on Summer Games and read analytics. However, no evidence states that the API matches the UI feature for feature, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, so there is no documented REST API surface. Missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity claim, a documented API reference or OpenAPI spec, coverage of features like pricing, playtest sharing and asset library through the API, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
